profiles.name: Andi Muhammad Suryady Bandy
profiles.description: Andi Muhammad Suryady Bandy represents Kalabakan, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Parliament records affiliation with Barisan Nasional (BN). Reports of suspended UMNO membership are recorded in the profile sources.
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament’s current BN label is retained. March 2026 reporting describes a continuing six-year UMNO suspension; active component-party membership or reinstatement was not established.
